claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cinalukast is a CysLT1 antagonist with no reported cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak effects reflecting PPARα modulation or nonspecific lipophilicity rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
